Peripheral seed index for Gonzalez selection (coordinates)

Source: R/seed.R
dot-PickPoints.Rd

Coordinate counterpart of .PickPoint(); each anchor is computed from the …FromPoints_cpp primitives, bit-identical to the matrix path on Euclidean data.

Usage

.PickPoints(points, strategy)

Arguments

points

A double N x dim coordinate matrix.

strategy

Anchor name; see PickPoint(). Also accepts "first" (1).

Value

.PickPoints() returns an integer seed index.
